_meta.note: Full CSF 2.0 core: 6 functions, 22 categories, 106 subcategories. Subcategories with a real AWS evidence source are 'measured' (the engine evaluates them); the rest are 'suggested' - the AWS service or third-party tool that would evidence the outcome, attested by a human.
_meta.source: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 (final)

controls.title: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities
controls.measure: Detective graphs suspicious activity to reveal related entities, timelines, and attack pathways.

controls.title: Information is correlated from multiple sources
controls.measure: events are correlated across sources into one queryable store.

controls.title: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood
controls.measure: Sentinel workbooks estimate incident scope by correlating affected assets, identities, and data volumes.

controls.title: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools
controls.measure: EventBridge routes adverse-event notifications from Security Hub to authorized staff and tools.

controls.title: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis
controls.measure: Recorded Future enriches adverse events with threat intelligence context and risk scores.

controls.title: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria
controls.measure: PagerDuty incident policies auto-declare incidents when alerts meet defined severity criteria.

controls.title: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
controls.measure: Amazon GuardDuty detector is enabled.

controls.title: The physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events
controls.measure: Splunk ingests badge access and CCTV alarm logs and alerts on unauthorized data-center entry.

controls.title: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events
controls.measure: CloudTrail is logging and multi-region (cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus).

controls.title: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
controls.measure: Wiz scans external cloud service configurations for drift and misconfigurations affecting delivery.

controls.title: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events
controls.measure: AWS Security Hub is enabled.

controls.title: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management
controls.measure: Current mission statement linked to the cybersecurity program charter in the GRC tool, re-approved by leadership annually.

controls.title: Internal and external stakeholders are understood, and their needs and expectations regarding cybersecurity risk management are understood and considered
controls.measure: Stakeholder register recording internal and external parties' cybersecurity expectations, reviewed and updated annually.

controls.title: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity - including privacy and civil liberties obligations - are understood and managed
controls.measure: Compliance obligation register mapping each applicable law, regulation, and contract clause to controls, refreshed quarterly.

controls.title: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated
controls.measure: Business impact analysis listing critical services and the external stakeholders depending on them, refreshed annually.

controls.title: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated
controls.measure: CMDB record per critical service showing dependencies and owners, attested by service owners annually.

controls.title: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction
controls.measure: Quarterly strategy review minutes linking risk KPI trends from the executive dashboard to documented strategy adjustments.

controls.title: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks
controls.measure: Audit Manager assessment showing every applicable requirement mapped to a control, with gaps tracked to closure.

controls.title: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed
controls.measure: Monthly KPI/KRI performance dashboard reviewed by leadership with actions logged for metrics outside tolerance.

controls.title: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced
controls.measure: Approved cybersecurity policy set published in the policy portal with owner, effective date, and mapping to organizational context.

controls.title: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission
controls.measure: Policy review timestamps within 12 months and employee attestation completion of at least 98% tracked in the policy tool.

controls.title: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders
controls.measure: Approved risk management objectives with stakeholder sign-off recorded in the GRC tool, reviewed annually.

controls.title: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained
controls.measure: Board-approved risk appetite and tolerance statement with communication log and review date within the last 12 months.

controls.title: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes
controls.measure: Cybersecurity risks entered in the enterprise risk register using the same scoring taxonomy and reporting cadence as ERM.

controls.title: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated
controls.measure: Documented risk response options (accept, mitigate, transfer, avoid) communicated to owners and applied to every register entry.

controls.title: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties
controls.measure: Cyber risk escalation matrix and on-call communication paths configured and exercised in a tabletop at least annually.

controls.title: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated
controls.measure: Standardized likelihood-and-impact risk scoring methodology configured in the GRC tool and applied to all risk entries.

controls.title: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions
controls.measure: Enterprise risk register includes opportunity (positive risk) entries with owners, reviewed alongside threat risks each cycle.

controls.title: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving
controls.measure: Board or executive charter assigning cybersecurity accountability, with minutes showing risk oversight activity each quarter.

controls.title: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced
controls.measure: Every IAM user carries an owner tag (iam:ListUserTags).

controls.title: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies
controls.measure: Approved security budget and staffing plan reconciled against the risk strategy, reviewed by leadership annually.

controls.title: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices
controls.measure: HR records showing security responsibilities in job descriptions and screening/onboarding completion for all in-scope staff.

controls.title: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders
controls.measure: Approved SCRM program (strategy, objectives, policies, process workflows) published and version-controlled in the TPRM platform.

controls.title: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally
controls.measure: Configured supplier risk workflows assigning cybersecurity responsibilities to suppliers, customers, and partners with named owners.

controls.title: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes
controls.measure: Supplier risks linked from the TPRM tool into the enterprise risk register and reported through the standard ERM cadence.

controls.title: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality
controls.measure: Tiered supplier inventory covering 100% of vendors with criticality ratings refreshed at least annually.

controls.title: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties
controls.measure: Percentage of active supplier contracts containing mandatory cybersecurity clause library language, reported quarterly.

controls.title: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships
controls.measure: Completed due-diligence assessment and risk rating for each new supplier before contract execution, with exceptions approved.

controls.title: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship
controls.measure: Continuous security ratings and risk records per tiered supplier with owners and remediation status reviewed quarterly.

controls.title: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities
controls.measure: Critical supplier escalation contacts embedded in incident response plans and exercised in at least one joint test annually.

controls.title: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programs, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle
controls.measure: SCA and SBOM findings from the software supply chain feed the GRC risk register with SLA-tracked remediation workflows.

controls.title: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement
controls.measure: Supplier offboarding records showing access deprovisioning and data return/destruction attestation completed within the defined SLA.

controls.title: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained
controls.measure: hardware inventory (EC2/EBS) is maintained and attributable.

controls.title: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained
controls.measure: AWS Config recorder and delivery channel are enabled.

controls.title: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained
controls.measure: authorized network/data-flow representations are maintained.

controls.title: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained
controls.measure: ServiceNow CMDB records each supplier-provided service with owner, contract dates, and dependencies on internal applications.

controls.title: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission
controls.measure: Assets carry criticality and data-classification tags; Axonius reports coverage and gaps for high-criticality assets.

controls.title: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained
controls.measure: Amazon Macie is enabled for data discovery.

controls.title: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles
controls.measure: AWS Config rules record lifecycle state for each resource, flagging EOL AMIs, unrotated keys, and deprecated versions.

controls.title: Improvements are identified from evaluations
controls.measure: Audit Manager assessments record control evaluation findings and corrective actions with owners tracked to closure.

controls.title: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties
controls.measure: Exercise and penetration-test findings are logged as Jira issues with lessons-learned items and remediation owners.

controls.title: Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes, procedures, and activities
controls.measure: Datadog incident records capture operational failures and each post-incident review action item with owner and due date.

controls.title: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved
controls.measure: Audit Manager collects IR-plan version history, approval attestations, and staff acknowledgment evidence each cycle.

controls.title: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded
controls.measure: Amazon Inspector is enabled for continuous vulnerability scanning.

controls.title: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources
controls.measure: Amazon GuardDuty detector is enabled (threat-intel feeds).

controls.title: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded
controls.measure: Amazon GuardDuty detector is enabled.

controls.title: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded
controls.measure: ServiceNow risk records score likelihood and impact for each threat-vulnerability pair from structured assessments.

controls.title: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization
controls.measure: Wiz security graph computes inherent-risk scores per asset from exposure, identity privileges, and data sensitivity.

controls.title: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated
controls.measure: Each risk response is recorded as a Jira issue with owner, due date, and linked risk ID tracked through closure.

controls.title: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked
controls.measure: ServiceNow change records log each change's risk assessment and approvals; exceptions carry owners and expiry dates.

controls.title: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established
controls.measure: vulnerability-disclosure intake, triage, and response process.

controls.title: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use
controls.measure: Snyk records SBOM, signature, and provenance verification for dependencies and images prior to deployment.

controls.title: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition
controls.measure: ServiceNow Vendor Risk records capture pre-acquisition supplier tiering, questionnaire scores, and reassessment dates.

controls.title: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization
controls.measure: No IAM access key is older than 90 days (iam:ListAccessKeys).

controls.title: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions
controls.measure: Identity-proofing workflow logs evidencing document/selfie verification bound to a credential at enrollment, with the assurance level recorded.

controls.title: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated
controls.measure: Every console user has MFA enabled (iam:ListUsers + iam:ListMFADevices).

controls.title: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified
controls.measure: SAML/OIDC assertion signatures and expiry are verified at each application.

controls.title: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties
controls.measure: entitlements are defined and periodically recertified.

controls.title: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk
controls.measure: Physical access control attestations from SOC 2/ISO reports covering badge, mantrap, and visitor logs at hosting facilities.

controls.title: Personnel are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind
controls.measure: Campaign completion records showing each employee's security awareness training and phishing-simulation results within required cadence.

controls.title: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind
controls.measure: Role-based training completion records for privileged/technical staff against specialized secure-development and incident-response curricula.

controls.title: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected
controls.measure: Every S3 bucket has default encryption (s3:GetBucketEncryption).

controls.title: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected
controls.measure: TLS listeners use modern protocols and non-expired certificates.

controls.title: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected
controls.measure: sensitive data in use is classified and protected (attested).

controls.title: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested
controls.measure: Snapshots are taken within 7 days (ec2:DescribeSnapshots).

controls.title: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage
controls.measure: No security group exposes a port to 0.0.0.0/0.

controls.title: The organization's technology assets are protected from environmental threats
controls.measure: Facility control attestations covering fire, flood, HVAC, and power protection for environmental-threat protection of technology assets.

controls.title: Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations
controls.measure: RDS instances are Multi-AZ.

controls.title: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained
controls.measure: Quota-utilization and capacity dashboards showing headroom thresholds and alarms maintain availability under peak load.

controls.title: Configuration management practices are established and applied
controls.measure: Every S3 bucket has versioning enabled (s3:GetBucketVersioning).

controls.title: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
controls.measure: software is patched and its lifecycle tracked.

controls.title: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
controls.measure: Fleet Manager hardware inventory records showing asset model, firmware, and lifecycle status for decommissioning decisions.

controls.title: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring
controls.measure: CloudTrail is logging and multi-region (cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus).

controls.title: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented
controls.measure: unauthorized software install/execution is prevented.

controls.title: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle
controls.measure: CI/CD scan records showing SAST/SCA/dependency checks gated and monitored at each SDLC stage for every build.

controls.title: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders
controls.measure: ServiceNow distributes recovery status and progress updates to designated stakeholder groups.

controls.title: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging
controls.measure: ServiceNow publishes approved public recovery statements through configured communication templates.

controls.title: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process
controls.measure: the recovery plan is executed and exercised in a drill.

controls.title: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed
controls.measure: DRS recovery plans select, scope, and prioritize which servers and recovery points to restore first.

controls.title: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration
controls.measure: backups are verified restorable through restore tests.

controls.title: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms
controls.measure: CloudWatch dashboards and alarms establish post-incident baselines for critical mission functions.

controls.title: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed
controls.measure: DRS post-launch verification confirms restored assets boot, pass health checks, and rejoin service.

controls.title: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria, and incident-related documentation is completed
controls.measure: Incident Manager closes the incident and generates a post-incident report documenting recovery end.

controls.title: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident
controls.measure: Mandiant responders perform forensic root-cause analysis and reconstruct attacker activity during incidents.

controls.title: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records' integrity and provenance are preserved
controls.measure: CloudTrail records investigator API actions, giving an immutable audit trail of investigation steps.

controls.title: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved
controls.measure: Sumo Logic indexes incident artifacts with hashes and chain-of-custody metadata to preserve provenance.

controls.title: An incident's magnitude is estimated and validated
controls.measure: Tenable estimates incident magnitude by quantifying affected assets and exposed vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents
controls.measure: Incident Manager notifies internal and external stakeholders using configured contact and escalation plans.

controls.title: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders
controls.measure: Cortex XSOAR shares incident indicators and reports with designated internal and external partners.

controls.title: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared
controls.measure: Incident Manager launches the response plan and engages third-party contacts and escalation channels.

controls.title: Incident reports are triaged and validated
controls.measure: ServiceNow Security Incident Response triages and validates incident reports against response playbooks.

controls.title: Incidents are categorized and prioritized
controls.measure: Jira Service Management categorizes and prioritizes incidents by severity, impact, and urgency.

controls.title: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed
controls.measure: PagerDuty escalation policies elevate incidents to higher on-call tiers and management when unacknowledged.

controls.title: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied
controls.measure: ServiceNow gates recovery initiation on defined exit criteria captured as workflow checkpoints.

controls.title: Incidents are contained
controls.measure: Network Firewall containment rules isolate compromised subnets and block malicious egress during response.

controls.title: Incidents are eradicated
controls.measure: Falcon Real Time Response eradicates threats by quarantining files and terminating malicious processes.
